title: A Multi-Layered AI Pipeline for BPMN Generation from Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.18157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The automated transformation of unstructured natural language process descriptions into Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) diagrams remains a challenging task, due to linguistic ambiguity and the difficulty to detect non-adjacent control-flow relationships. This paper proposes a solution for generating BPMN models from natural language descriptions through a multi-layered pipeline that integrates transformer-based architectures, Large Language Models and ontology population. translated_title: 从自然语言生成BPMN的多层AI流水线
translated_abstract: 将非结构化的自然语言流程描述自动转换为业务流程模型与标记法图仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，其原因在于语言歧义性以及检测非相邻控制流关系的困难。本文提出了一种通过多层流水线从自然语言描述生成BPMN模型的解决方案，该流水线集成了基于Transformer的架构、大语言模型和本体填充。所提出的方法以自然语言描述为起点，将文本处理、控制流关系提取和结构验证分离到专门的组件中。实体提取通过经过微调的基于RoBERTa的Transformer模型完成，而控制流引擎通过基于大语言模型的推理来捕获非相邻关系。为了在有限可用数据下提高泛化能力，该方法采用了动态少样本策略。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种集成基于Transformer的架构、大语言模型和本体填充的多层AI流水线，通过微调RoBERTa模型进行实体提取、利用LLM推理捕获非相邻控制流关系，并采用动态少样本策略提升有限数据下的泛化能力，从而实现从自然语言描述自动生成BPMN流程图。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-layered AI pipeline integrating transformer-based architectures, LLMs, and ontology population to automatically generate BPMN diagrams from natural language, using a fine-tuned RoBERTa model for entity extraction and LLM-based inference to capture non-adjacent control-flow relationships, enhanced by a dynamic few-shot strategy for better generalization under limited data.
